review.use_summary: Used hifiasm 0.19.5-r592 in default HiFi-only mode for each sample, yielding a partially phased diploid assembly graph subsequently converted into two FASTA sequence files.
review.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the explicit partially phased status. Source-bound graph-to-FASTA export does not certify full phasing or identify the exact paper binary. Two upstream commits report r592; this integration binds one immutable official commit explicitly rather than inferring which the paper used.

review.use_summary: Assembled HiFi reads from 32 broomcorn millet accessions into raw contigs using hifiasm 0.14.2-r315 with -l2 -u, before separate RagTag 2.0.1 reference anchoring and orientation.
review.implementation_scope_note: Retain the reported purge level and disabled post-join setting. RagTag creates the chromosome-scale anchoring step; hifiasm alone is not credited with it. Bounded synthetic -f0 controls do not reproduce unspecified paper Bloom settings.

review.use_summary: Used hifiasm 0.19.5-r587 to construct contig-level grape assemblies from HiFi, ONT and Hi-C data; separate RagTag, Juicer/3D-DNA, visualization and ONT gap-filling steps produced the reported final haplotypes.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph does not report exact hifiasm flags or ONT length selection. The available mixed-read/Hi-C adapter family does not establish those missing settings. Preserve the separate scaffolding, gap filling, polishing and assessment roles; hifiasm execution alone does not reproduce the eighteen reported T2T haplotypes.

review.use_summary: Generated mouse haplotype assemblies using hifiasm 0.19.5 in trio-binning mode with HiFi and ONT reads and strain-specific parental k-mer databases made with Yak 0.1-r66-dirty; RagTag subsequently anchored the contigs.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper gives no hifiasm revision suffix and its dirty Yak build is not frozen by the version label. Native direct counting and source-compatible YAK serialization/classification are separate from reproducing Yak Bloom-filter admission or the dirty paper runtime. Merqury-parent databases belong to the separate Verkko branch. Do not infer raw-read subsets or full T2T reproduction.

review.use_summary: Used hifiasm 0.22.0-r689 for hybrid HiFi plus ONT ultra-long contig construction and a separate ONT-only assembly in wheat; the hybrid-derived assembly later served as the reference framework for independent scaffolding and iterative gap filling.
review.implementation_scope_note: Keep the hybrid UL length >100 kb and QV >10 selection distinct from an unreported ONT-only input subset. Original ONT-only mode requires FASTQ qualities; this adapter rejects FASTA before upstream's exit0 error. Verkko, chromosome-specific NextDenovo, organelle filtering, AnchorWave and final gap filling remain separate tools and steps.

review.implementation_scope_note: The revision suffix is unreported. BUSCO, BWA, minimap2 and Merqury provide separate completeness, mapping and k-mer assessments.
